description: Two grid items placed in the same cell, offset so they partially overlap: 'front' comes first in source order (would lose a plain document-order tie) but has z-index: 1, so it must still paint on top of 'back' in the overlapping region.

florui.css: .stack { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 60px; grid-template-rows: 60px; width: 60px; height: 60px; } .stack .front { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #00aa00; z-index: 1; } .stack .back { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #cc0000; margin-top: 20px; margin-left: 20px; }

classification.reason: Same anti-aliasing/hinting mismatch between Chromium's own rasterizer and Florui's skrifa+tiny-skia one already calibrated for the bare-element fixtures -- this fixture has no text, only flat fills, so the real number is expected to land near the low end of that range.
